text:
rana: Quick sync 1: spotted two problems in Optimize toolkit docs during the daily sweep: 1) a handful of example links point to /assets/obsidian/* and 404 on the live site; 2) quant-profiles.md still shows a v1 BatchClient snippet that confuses customers. Low-risk PRs to fix both?
eli: thanks for catching. i'll take the obsidian path fixes. should we canonicalize to /static/examples and add redirects?
rana: yes, canonicalize to /static/examples and add a short note that older bookmarks redirect. also remove any stray obsidian metadata blocks.
harper: i will update quant-profiles.md. can you paste the v2 snippet we should use?
eli: also found inconsistent option names: some examples use kv_prefetch, others kv_prefetch_enabled. let's standardize to kv_prefetch_enabled per SDK.
rana: good catch. harper, here's the v2 snippet to land:
```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
c = OptimizeClient()
profile = {"name":"shortseq-fallback","heuristics":{"short_seq_threshold":64,"fallback_model":"redwood/small-compat"}}
c.apply_quant_profile(profile)
```
harper: thanks. i'll add a brief migration blurb: map v1 BatchClient -> OptimizeClient.optimize_route and mention that prefetch_window affects batching heuristics while batch_size targets server-side grouping.
docs-bot: lint/links check queued for PRs.
eli: opening PR #8002 for path fixes; will include a tiny redirect in staging config.
harper: opening PR #8003 for snippet + migration blurb + short how-to for regression checks. I'll suggest adding a small eval prompt set and check token-level perplexity after quant changes.
deploy-bot: docs-ci: PR #8003 lint passed, mkdocs build passed. PR #8002 failed mkdocs due to missing image asset.
eli: patched image path and pushed. PR #8002 now mkdocs passed.
rana: can reviewers @eng-docs and @product-docs please review both PRs? target to merge before Tue release snapshot.
harper: added migration table and a tiny example showing prefetch_window=8 with kv_cache enabled.
eli: standardized all variable names to kv_prefetch_enabled. pushed.
docs-bot: both PRs now ready for review.
rana: thanks team, i'll run a final smoke after merge and add changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md.
